# vastdata_compute_cluster_deployments (Data Source)

Kubernetes deployments in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_deployments" "tf_test_cluster_deployments" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `deployments` (Attributes List) Kubernetes deployments in the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deployments))

<a id="nestedatt--deployments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deployments`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number) Number of available replicas.
- `created_at` (String) Deployment creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Deployment name.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace where the deployment is located.
- `ready` (String) Ready replicas in "X/Y" format (like kubectl).
- `up_to_date` (Number) Number of up-to-date replicas.
